title: Amicro
brief: A curated gallery of premium React micro-interaction and transition components built with React and Motion, with layout inspired by transition.dev. It showcases around 36 named interactions — morph, glare shine, magnetic field, text reveal, focus blur, shake, rotate, color-morph buttons — as ready-to-use UI components. Licensing and copy-paste terms are not stated on the page, so reusability is uncertain.
details: Amicro (amicro.vercel.app) is a curated library of premium micro-interactions and transition components built with React and Motion, focused on the small details that make interfaces feel polished. It catalogs dozens of named interactions — morph, glare shine, magnetic field, text reveal, shake, ring, expand ring, rotate, color morph, focus blur, and more — each demonstrated as a ready-to-use component (its layout takes inspiration from transition.dev). Its GitHub repository has gathered over two thousand stars, and the site also points readers toward Oxygen UI for fuller ready-made components. Useful as a drop-in source of tasteful button, icon, and control animations without designing each easing curve from scratch.
